publishedMetadata.title: Stale time and garbage collection
publishedMetadata.description: A practical TanStack Query 5 lesson on stale time and garbage collection, with a real starter bug, instructor repair, HTTP/cache invariants and a separate browser or Next SSR acceptance exercise.
objectives: Separate staleTime freshness from gcTime eviction of unused cache entries, and predict focus/refetch behavior.
Read immediately twice, refocus at 2 seconds, then refocus after 11 seconds. Explain which reads should reuse cached data and when inactive queries are garbage-collected.
Never assume cache freshness is authorization. A 401/403 must be handled at the server boundary even if a previous cached object existed.
